information.description:
Hounds are some of the harder muscle among scavenger groups, typically with a heftier amount of stolen cyberware and marginally heavier weapons. Still not a huge threat, but can be lethal if not engaged with a modicum of caution.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Scavengers).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

The Nova is a traditional revolver that offers substantial firepower at a reasonable price. Its classic cylinder harkens back to the times of the Wild West. And while the Nova is prone to failure, it's also easy to fix thanks to its simple design and construction. It can be found in NCPD weapon lockers, in small-time corporate arsenals, tucked in the belts of gangoons and stowed in women's handbags.

Cost: 250eb (Premium)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
Simple Leather armor for your head. No armor penalty.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
Must be paired. Provides immunity to dazzling effects (like flashbangs).
Must be paired. Provides immunity to dazzling effects (like flashbangs).

Cost: 100eb (Premium) ♦ Install: Mall

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Originally intended for special operations use, this quickly-abandoned implant enables projecting a one-way holographic mask over the user’s face, entirely obscuring it while still providing full vision.

External Body Cyberware. While active, this cyberware masks the user's face from external sources, including cameras. Anyone attempting a Human Perception or Lip Reading check against users with this cyberware active takes a -2 penalty to their check. Counts as an instance of Gang Colors Jewelry for Scavengers, if tweaked to the right display setting. Turning this cyberware on or off takes an Action. NOTE: This is the digital facemask that Scavs use in 2077. The World of 2077 book specifically mentions “K.E.R.S” for the Scavengers, so that’s what this was inspired by.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
